            $1::text[], $2::timestamptz[], $3::bigint[], $4::int[],
            $5::numeric[], $6::numeric[], $7::numeric[], $8::numeric[], $9::float8[],
            $10::numeric[], $11::numeric[]
        )
        ON CONFLICT (pool_address, bin_id, ts) DO NOTHING
